experiment.title: Fresh p16267 sampled typed-TT locator with matched rho
experiment.objective: Test whether deterministic sampled suffix columns preserve typed five-term relation support and quotient rank on the next fresh ordinary prime-field curve, with matched Pollard-rho cost records captured by the repository harness.
stopping_rules: stop a budget at full support/rank failure and retain the failure
stop the run on timeout or memory limit and classify it as infrastructure/resource evidence
invalidation_rules: do not interpret a missing sub-full relation as a solver failure
do not promote a toy fixed-curve cost reduction to an exponent or deployed-key claim
invalidate if the full control, direct witness checks, or matched rho certificates fail
experiment.success_criterion: At least one sub-full budget preserves exact projected support, held-out expected witnesses, valid witnesses, and relation rank on p16267 while reducing predicted entries and charged source/reconstruction work.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Full replay fails, or every sub-full budget misses support/coverage, loses rank, or has no measured cost reduction after all charged metrics.
